<!DOCTYPE html>
<!-- saved from url=(0082)file:///C:/Users/david.samuel_even/Downloads/even_healthcare_dashboard%20(21).html -->
<html lang="en"><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pan India Heat Sheet — EVEN HEALTHCARE</title>
<style>
* { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0; }
:root {
  --bg:       #f0f2f5;
  --panel:    #ffffff;
  --panel2:   #f7f8fa;
  --border:   #e0e4ed;
  --text:     #1a1f36;
  --muted:    #6b7a9e;
  --green:    #2ecc71;
  --orange:   #f5a623;
  --pink:     #e91e8c;
  --blue:     #4a90d9;
  --pin:      #f5a623;
  --pin-dark: #c97f10;
}
body {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  height: 100vh;
  max-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: 0;
}

/* TOP BAR */
.topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 24px;
  height: 68px;
  background: var(--panel);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(26,31,54,.08);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.topbar-left { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; }
.topbar h1 { font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.brand-tag { font-size:.7rem; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; }
.topbar .date-box {
  font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}
.topbar-right { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }

/* UPDATE DATA BUTTON */
.update-data-btn {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all .2s;
}
.update-data-btn:hover, .update-data-btn.open {
  border-color: var(--green);
  color: var(--green);
}

/* SLIDE-DOWN PANEL */
.data-panel {
  max-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  background: var(--panel);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.data-panel.visible { max-height: 320px; }
.data-inner {
  padding: 20px 28px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: start;
}
.data-title { font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--text); margin-bottom:4px; }
.data-desc { font-size:.73rem; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:12px; }
.data-desc code { background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border); padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-size:.7rem; color:var(--orange); }
.paste-area {
  width:100%; height:140px;
  background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 12px;
  color:var(--text); font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:.72rem;
  resize:none; outline:none; line-height:1.5;
  transition:border-color .2s;
}
.paste-area:focus { border-color:var(--blue); }
.data-actions { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:10px; }
.btn-apply {
  flex:1; padding:9px;
  background:var(--green); border:none; border-radius:8px;
  color:#0f1117; font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s;
}
.btn-apply:hover { background:#27ae60; }
.btn-clear { padding:9px 14px; background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.82rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s; }
.btn-clear:hover { border-color:var(--pink); color:var(--pink); }
.data-status { font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; padding:5px 10px; border-radius:6px; margin-top:8px; display:none; }
.data-status.ok  { background:rgba(46,204,113,.15); color:var(--green); display:block; }
.data-status.err { background:rgba(245,166,35,.15);  color:var(--orange); display:block; }
.data-steps { background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:16px; }
.steps-title { font-size:.62rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.1em; margin-bottom:10px; }
.step { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; font-size:.74rem; color:var(--muted); }
.step:last-child { margin-bottom:0; }
.step-num { width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); color:#0f1117; font-size:.6rem; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:1px; }

/* MAIN */
.main {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  overflow: hidden;
  min-height: 0;
}
.map-area { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; }

/* LEFT SIDEBAR */
.sidebar {
  background: var(--panel);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 18px 16px;
  gap: 0;
  height: 100%;
}
.section-label {
  font-size: .62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.view-toggle {
  display: flex;
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.view-toggle button {
  flex: 1; padding: 8px 0;
  background: transparent; border: none;
  color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s;
  letter-spacing: .03em;
}
.view-toggle button.active { background: var(--text); color: var(--bg); }
.filter-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color .15s;
  user-select: none;
}
.filter-row:hover { border-color: var(--blue); }
.filter-row.active-filter { border-color: #555; }
.dot {
  width: 10px; height: 10px;
  border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: 10px;
}
.dot.green  { background: var(--green);  box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green); }
.dot.orange { background: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--orange); }
.dot.pink   { background: var(--pink);   box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--pink); }
.filter-row span { flex: 1; font-size: .82rem; }
.filter-count { font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.total-box {
  background: var(--panel2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 14px;
}
.total-num { font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; margin: 4px 0 10px; }
.mini-bar { height: 4px; border-radius: 3px; display: flex; overflow: hidden; gap: 2px; }
.mini-bar div { border-radius: 3px; }
.cities-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.city-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.city-row:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.city-row.active { background: var(--panel2); border-color: var(--border); }
.cname { font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; display: inline; }
.ctotal { font-size: .7rem; color: var(--orange); vertical-align: super; margin-left: 2px; }
.czone  { font-size: .68rem; color: var(--muted); display: block; margin-top: 1px; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; }

/* MAP CENTER */
.map-area {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:#ffffff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
}
.map-area img.map-img {
  max-height: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  opacity: 1;
  user-select: none;
  display: block;
  filter: none;
}
.marker {
  position: absolute;
  transform: translate(-50%, -100%);
  cursor: pointer;
  z-index: 10;
  transition: transform .15s, filter .15s;
}
.marker:hover { transform: translate(-50%,-100%) scale(1.15); z-index: 20; }
.marker.active-mk { transform: translate(-50%,-100%) scale(1.18); z-index: 25; }
.pin-body {
  width: 22px; height: 22px;
  background: var(--pin);
  border: 2px solid #fff;
  border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0;
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  transition: background .18s;
  position: relative;
}
.marker.active-mk .pin-body { background: #fff; border-color: var(--pin); }
.marker.active-mk .pin-body span { color: var(--pin); }
.pin-body span { transform: rotate(45deg); color: #1a1a2e; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; }
.pin-pulse {
  position: absolute;
  width: 32px; height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid var(--pin);
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg);
  opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
}
.marker.active-mk .pin-pulse { animation: pulse 1.6s ease-out infinite; }
@keyframes pulse {
  0%   { opacity:.6; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg) scale(.4); }
  100% { opacity:0;  transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg) scale(2.2); }
}
/* City name label — appears above the pin */
.pin-label {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 26px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: rgba(15,17,23,.82);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: 800;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  letter-spacing: .03em;
}
/* Amount label — appears below the pin tip */
.pin-amt {
  position: absolute;
  top: 26px; left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: rgba(46,204,113,.92);
  color: #0a1f0d;
  font-size: 7.5px; font-weight: 900;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 5px;
  pointer-events: none;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}
.marker.active-mk .pin-amt { background: var(--pin); color: #1a1a2e; }

/* RIGHT PANEL */
.right-panel {
  background: var(--panel);
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 18px 16px;
  gap: 0;
  height: 100%;
}
.city-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; }
.city-meta { font-family:'Courier New',monospace; font-size:.72rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.city-meta span { margin:0 6px; }
.comp-label { font-size:.65rem; color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.1em; }
.comp-bar { height:8px; border-radius:6px; display:flex; overflow:hidden; gap:3px; margin-top:6px; }
.comp-bar div { border-radius:6px; transition:flex .4s; }
.stat-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px; }
.stat-card { background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; }
.slabel { font-size:.6rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:4px; }
.sval { font-size:1.9rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1; }
.spct { font-size:.68rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px; }
.stat-card.green-card  .sval { color:var(--green); }
.stat-card.orange-card .sval { color:var(--orange); }
.stat-card.pink-card   .sval { color:var(--pink); }
.stat-card.white-card  .sval { color:var(--text); }
.edit-section { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; }
.edit-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
.elabel { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex:1; font-size:.8rem; }
.edit-input {
  width:80px; padding:7px 10px;
  background:var(--panel2); border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:7px; color:var(--text);
  font-size:.85rem; font-weight:600; text-align:center;
  outline:none; transition:border-color .15s;
}
.edit-input:focus { border-color:var(--blue); }
.save-btn {
  width:100%; padding:13px;
  background:var(--green); border:none; border-radius:10px;
  color:#0f1117; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:800;
  cursor:pointer; letter-spacing:.04em;
  transition:background .15s, transform .1s;
}
.save-btn:hover { background:#27ae60; }
.save-btn:active { transform:scale(.98); }

/* Even Pay badge */
.ep-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-size:.68rem; font-weight:700; margin-top:4px; }
.ep-badge.yes { background:rgba(46,204,113,.15); color:var(--green); }
.ep-badge.no  { background:rgba(245,166,35,.15);  color:var(--orange); }

::-webkit-scrollbar { width:4px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background:transparent; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background:var(--border); border-radius:4px; }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TV DISPLAY — Maximum visibility for large screens
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Score cards ── */
.tv-card {
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:14px 16px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--panel2);
  flex-shrink:0;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.tv-card::before {
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;bottom:6px;
  width:6px;border-radius:4px;
}
.tv-card-blue::before   { background:#4a90d9; }
.tv-card-blue   { border-left:3px solid #4a90d9; }
.tv-card-blue .tv-card-label  { color:#4a90d9; }
.tv-card-blue .tv-card-amount { color:#4a90d9; }
.tv-card-blue .tv-card-sub    { color:#4a90d9cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-card-green::before  { background:#2ecc71; }
.tv-card-green  { border-left:3px solid #2ecc71; }
.tv-card-green .tv-card-label  { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-card-green .tv-card-amount { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-card-green .tv-card-sub    { color:#2ecc71cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-card-orange::before { background:#f5a623; }
.tv-card-orange { border-left:3px solid #f5a623; }
.tv-card-orange .tv-card-label  { color:#f5a623; }
.tv-card-orange .tv-card-amount { color:#f5a623; }
.tv-card-orange .tv-card-sub    { color:#f5a623cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-card-red::before    { background:#e91e8c; }
.tv-card-red    { border-left:3px solid #e91e8c; }
.tv-card-red .tv-card-label  { color:#e91e8c; }
.tv-card-red .tv-card-amount { color:#e91e8c; }
.tv-card-red .tv-card-sub    { color:#e91e8ccc; font-weight:700; }

.tv-card-label {
  font-size:.60rem;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  color:var(--muted);
}
.tv-card-amount {
  font-size:1.85rem;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.tv-card-sub {
  font-size:.72rem;
  font-weight:600;
  margin-top:4px;
  color:var(--muted);
  letter-spacing:.01em;
}
.tv-paid-label {
  font-size:.60rem;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
.tv-paid-amount {
  font-size:1.85rem;
  font-weight:900;
  color:var(--text);
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.tv-paid-sub {
  font-size:.72rem;
  font-weight:600;
  color:var(--muted);
  margin-top:4px;
}
.tv-zone-name { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--text); }
.tv-zone-right { text-align:right; }
.tv-zone-amt  { font-size:.9rem;  font-weight:900; }
.tv-zone-cnt  { font-size:.66rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.tv-zone-row {
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:11px 12px 10px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--panel2);
  margin-bottom:8px;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.tv-zone-row::before {
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;bottom:6px;
  width:4px;border-radius:3px;
}
.tv-zone-row-top { display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:7px; }
.tv-zone-name { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--text); }
.tv-zone-amt  { font-size:.92rem; font-weight:900; }
.tv-zone-cnt  { font-size:.66rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
.tv-zone-bar-track { height:4px; background:var(--border); border-radius:3px; overflow:hidden; }
.tv-zone-bar-fill  { height:100%; border-radius:3px; transition:width .8s; }

/* ── City breakdown rows ── */
.tv-city-row {
  padding:9px 11px;
  border-radius:9px;
  margin-bottom:5px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--panel2);
  cursor:pointer;
  transition:border-color .15s;
}
.tv-city-row:hover { border-color:#4a90d9; }
.tv-city-header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:5px; }
.tv-city-name { font-size:.88rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--text); }
.tv-city-amt  { font-size:.88rem; font-weight:900; color:#4a90d9; }

.tv-city-leads { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; }
.tv-lead-row {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  padding:4px 8px; border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(74,144,217,.06); border:1px solid rgba(74,144,217,.12);
}
.tv-lead-name { font-size:.73rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--text); }
.tv-lead-amt  { font-size:.73rem; font-weight:800; color:#4a90d9; }
.tv-lead-ep   { font-size:.58rem; font-weight:900; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(46,204,113,.22); color:#2ecc71; margin-left:5px; }

/* ── RIGHT panel paid cards ── */
.tv-paid-card {
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:14px 16px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--panel2);
  flex-shrink:0;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.tv-paid-card::before {
  content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:6px;bottom:6px;
  width:6px;border-radius:4px;
}
.tv-paid-card.total::before { background:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.total { border-left:3px solid #2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.total .tv-paid-label  { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.total .tv-paid-amount { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.total .tv-paid-sub    { color:#2ecc71cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-paid-card.ep::before    { background:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.ep    { border-left:3px solid #2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.ep .tv-paid-label  { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.ep .tv-paid-amount { color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-card.ep .tv-paid-sub    { color:#2ecc71cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-paid-card.clinic::before{ background:#f5a623; }
.tv-paid-card.clinic{ border-left:3px solid #f5a623; }
.tv-paid-card.clinic .tv-paid-label  { color:#f5a623; }
.tv-paid-card.clinic .tv-paid-amount { color:#f5a623; }
.tv-paid-card.clinic .tv-paid-sub    { color:#f5a623cc; font-weight:700; }
.tv-paid-card.adp::before   { background:#e91e8c; }
.tv-paid-card.adp   { border-left:3px solid #e91e8c; }
.tv-paid-card.adp .tv-paid-label  { color:#e91e8c; }
.tv-paid-card.adp .tv-paid-amount { color:#e91e8c; }
.tv-paid-card.adp .tv-paid-sub    { color:#e91e8ccc; font-weight:700; }


/* ── Paid zone rows ── */
.tv-paid-zone-row {
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  padding:9px 12px; border-radius:9px; margin-bottom:5px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border); background:var(--panel2);
}
.tv-paid-zone-name { font-size:.85rem; font-weight:800; color:var(--text); }
.tv-paid-zone-amt  { font-size:.9rem;  font-weight:900; }
.tv-paid-zone-cnt  { font-size:.66rem; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; text-align:right; }

/* ── Paid city rows ── */
.tv-paid-city-row {
  padding:10px 13px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:6px;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(46,204,113,.25);
  background:rgba(46,204,113,.04);
}
.tv-paid-city-hdr { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:6px; }
.tv-paid-city-name  { font-size:.88rem; font-weight:900; color:var(--text); }
.tv-paid-city-total { font-size:.92rem; font-weight:900; color:#2ecc71; }

.tv-paid-lead-item {
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  padding:5px 9px; border-radius:7px;
  background:rgba(46,204,113,.08); border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,.18);
  margin-bottom:4px;
}
.tv-paid-lead-name  { font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--text); }
.tv-paid-lead-right { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
.tv-paid-lead-amt   { font-size:.8rem;  font-weight:900; color:#2ecc71; }
.tv-paid-lead-ep    { font-size:.58rem; font-weight:900; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; background:rgba(46,204,113,.25); color:#2ecc71; }

/* ── Sidebar wider for TV ── */
.sidebar { flex-shrink:0; width:300px; min-width:200px; max-width:460px; }
.right-panel { flex-shrink:0; width:293px; min-width:220px; max-width:540px; }

/* ── COLLAPSIBLE TOGGLE HEADERS ── */
.tv-toggle-hdr {
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  cursor:pointer; padding:8px 0 6px;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom:0;
  user-select:none;
}
.tv-toggle-hdr:hover .tv-toggle-btn { border-color:var(--green); color:var(--green); }
.tv-toggle-btn {
  font-size:.6rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.1em;
  padding:3px 10px; border-radius:6px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--border);
  background:var(--panel2); color:var(--muted);
  cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s;
  flex-shrink:0;
}
.tv-toggle-btn.open { background:var(--green); color:#0a1f0d; border-color:var(--green); }
.tv-collapsible {
  animation:fadeDown .2s ease;
  margin-top:6px;
}
@keyframes fadeDown { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)} }

.rp-toggle-hdr:hover .tv-toggle-btn { border-color:var(--green); color:var(--green); }

/* ── RIGHT PANEL SECTION TITLES ── */
.rp-section-title {
  font-size:.62rem;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.18em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);
  margin:0; padding:0;
}


/* ── RESIZERS ─────────────────────────────── */
.resizer-h {
  /* horizontal drag handle — resizes header height */
  width: 100%;
  height: 5px;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: ns-resize;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 50;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.resizer-h:hover, .resizer-h.dragging { background: var(--green); }
.resizer-h::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%; top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  width: 40px; height: 3px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--border);
}
.resizer-h:hover::after, .resizer-h.dragging::after { background: var(--green); }

.resizer-v {
  /* vertical drag handle — resizes panel widths */
  width: 5px;
  height: 100%;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: ew-resize;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 50;
  transition: background .15s;
}
.resizer-v:hover, .resizer-v.dragging { background: var(--green); }
.resizer-v::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  width: 3px; height: 40px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--border);
}
.resizer-v:hover::after, .resizer-v.dragging::after { background: var(--green); }
</style>
<script id="gviz-script"></script></head>

style="color:#f5a623;">₹0</div></div><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;"><div><div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Payments</div><div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Even Pay</div><div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">0</div></div><div><div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Added Today</div><div style="width:0%;background:#f5a623;"></div></div></div></div><div id="city-right" class="tv-collapsible" style="display:none;overflow-y:auto;flex:1;"><div style="text-align:center;padding:24px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;opacity:.6;">No paid leads yet</div></div></div>

</div>

<script>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   COLUMN NAMES (exact match from sheet)
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
// ── Smart column resolver ────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Maps logical field → list of possible header names (case-insensitive, partial match)
// Works with ANY CSV regardless of extra/renamed columns

var COL_ALIASES = {
  CITY     : ['rm city','clinic city','city','location','branch','rm_city'],
  AMOUNT   : ['sum of expected amount','expected amount','amount','sale value','sum of amount','total amount','sum_of_expected_amount'],
  EVENPAY  : ['is even pay','isevenpay','is_even_pay','even pay','evenpay','ep','ep fee','ep value'],
  POD      : ['pod update','pod_update','pod','payment status','payment update','update status'],
  PAID_AMT : ['paid amount','paid_amount','paid amt','payment amount','amount paid','actual paid','paid'],
  COMMENTS : ['comments','comment','notes','note','remark','remarks'],
  OWNER    : ['owner','sales owner','manager','team lead'],
  FUNNEL   : ['funnel type','funnel','stage','pipeline'],
  PARTNER  : ['partner type','partner','referral type','source type'],
  LEAD     : ['first name','firstname','first_name','lead name','name','client name','patient name'],
  DATE     : ['expected closure date','closure date','expected date','date','expected_closure_date'],
};

// Resolved mapping — populated after headers are known
var showingAllCities = false;
let C = { CITY:'', AMOUNT:'', EVENPAY:'', POD:'', PAID_AMT:'', COMMENTS:'', OWNER:'', FUNNEL:'', PARTNER:'', LEAD:'', PHONE:'', CLINIC:'' };

function resolveColumns(hdrs) {
  const lower = hdrs.map(h => h.toLowerCase().trim());
  Object.keys(COL_ALIASES).forEach(key => {
    const aliases = COL_ALIASES[key];
    // exact match first
    let found = aliases.find(a => lower.includes(a));
    if (found) { C[key] = hdrs[lower.indexOf(found)]; return; }
    // partial match
    found = aliases.find(a => lower.some(h => h.includes(a) || a.includes(h)));
    if (found) {
      const idx = lower.findIndex(h => h.includes(found) || found.includes(h));
      C[key] = hdrs[idx];
    }
  });
  console.log('Column mapping resolved:', C);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   CITY CONFIG  (zone + map pin position)
   px/py = position on the 855×980 native map
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
const CITY_CONFIG = [
  // NORTH
  { name:'Delhi',     zone:'North',   px:193, py:211 },
  { name:'Jaipur',    zone:'North',   px:163, py:251 },
  { name:'Indore',    zone:'North',   px:165, py:349 },
  // SOUTH
  { name:'Hyderabad', zone:'South',   px:220, py:471 },
  { name:'Bangalore', zone:'South',   px:201, py:573 },
  { name:'Chennai',   zone:'South',   px:257, py:571 },
  // WEST
  { name:'Mumbai',    zone:'West',    px:102, py:432 },
  { name:'Pune',      zone:'West',    px:122, py:445 },
  { name:'Nagpur',    zone:'West',    px:232, py:384 },
];

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   STATE
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
let rawRows = [], headers = [];
let viewMode  = 'count';
let activeFilters = { with:true, without:true };
let selectedCity  = null;
const NAT_W = 620, NAT_H = 710;

/* aggregate per city from rawRows */
// Detect if a row's Pod Update means "Paid"
function getPaidAmount(r) {
  // PRIMARY: use the dedicated "Paid Amount" column if it has a numeric value > 0
  var paidCol = C.PAID_AMT || 'Paid Amount';
  var paidCols = [paidCol, 'Paid Amount', 'paid amount', 'Paid amount'];
  for (var i = 0; i < paidCols.length; i++) {
    var v = String(r[paidCols[i]] || '').trim();
    var n = parseFloat(v.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
    if (!isNaN(n) && n > 0) return n;
  }
  // Scan any column with 'paid' in its name that has a number
  var keys = Object.keys(r);
  for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
    if (keys[j].toLowerCase().indexOf('paid') >= 0) {
      var val = String(r[keys[j]] || '').trim();
      var num = parseFloat(val.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
      if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) return num;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

function isPaid(r) {
  // PRIMARY: Paid Amount column has a value > 0
  if (getPaidAmount(r) > 0) return true;
  // SECONDARY: Pod Update column contains word "paid"
  var podCol = C.POD || 'Pod Update';
  var podCols = [podCol, 'Pod Update', 'pod update', 'Pod update'];
  for (var i = 0; i < podCols.length; i++) {
    var v = String(r[podCols[i]] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (/paid/.test(v)) return true;
  }
  // TERTIARY: scan all columns with 'pod','update','status' in name
  var keys = Object.keys(r);
  for (var j = 0; j < keys.length; j++) {
    var k = keys[j].toLowerCase();
    if (k.indexOf('pod') >= 0 || k === 'update' || k === 'status') {
      var val = String(r[keys[j]] || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (/paid/.test(val)) return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function hasEvenPay(r) {
  // Try resolved column first, then common names, then scan all columns with 'even' or 'ep'
  var epCols = [C.EVENPAY, 'Even pay consultation fee', 'Even pay', 'Even Pay Consultation Fee',
                'Even Pay Consultation fee', 'even pay consultation fee'].filter(Boolean);
  var epVal = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < epCols.length; i++) {
    if (r[epCols[i]] !== undefined && r[epCols[i]] !== null) {
      epVal = String(r[epCols[i]]).trim();
      if (epVal) break;
    }
  }
  // Also scan dynamically for any column with 'even' in its name
  if (!epVal) {
    Object.keys(r).forEach(function(k) {
      if (!epVal && (k.toLowerCase().indexOf('even') >= 0 || k.toLowerCase().indexOf('ep fee') >= 0)) {
        epVal = String(r[k]).trim();
      }
    });
  }
  if (!epVal || epVal === '0' || epVal.toLowerCase() === 'no' || epVal.toLowerCase() === 'n/a' || epVal.toLowerCase() === 'false') return false;
  var num = parseFloat(epVal.replace(/[^0-9.-]/g, ''));
  if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) return true;
  if (epVal.toLowerCase() === 'yes' || epVal.toLowerCase() === 'true') return true;
  return false;
}

function buildCityData() {
  // City name aliases — maps sheet variations to CITY_CONFIG names
  var CITY_ALIASES = {
    'bengaluru':'bangalore','bengalure':'bangalore','bangaluru':'bangalore',
    'bombay':'mumbai','new delhi':'delhi','ncr':'delhi','delhi ncr':'delhi',
    'hyd':'hyderabad','blr':'bangalore','chn':'chennai','mum':'mumbai',
    'pun':'pune','nag':'nagpur','ind':'indore','jai':'jaipur','del':'delhi'
  };
  const out = {};
  CITY_CONFIG.forEach(c => out[c.name.toLowerCase()] = {
    name:c.name, zone:c.zone, px:c.px, py:c.py,
    with:0, without:0, amount:0, paid:0, paidAmt:0, rows:[]
  });
  var _fr=(typeof getFilteredRows==="function"?getFilteredRows():rawRows);
  _fr.forEach(function(r) {
    var _city = r[C.CITY] || r['RM City'] || r['Clinic City'] || r['City'] || r['city'] || r['rm city'] || '';
    if (!_city) {
      Object.keys(r).forEach(function(k){ if (!_city && k.toLowerCase().indexOf('city') >= 0) _city = r[k]; });
    }
    var cityVal = String(_city).trim().toLowerCase();
    // Apply alias
    if (CITY_ALIASES[cityVal]) cityVal = CITY_ALIASES[cityVal];
    if (!out[cityVal]) return;
    const hasEP = hasEvenPay(r);
    const amtRaw = C.AMOUNT ? (r[C.AMOUNT]||'') : '';
    const amt = parseFloat(String(amtRaw).replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0;
    out[cityVal].amount += amt;
    out[cityVal].rows.push(r);
    if (hasEP) out[cityVal].with++; else out[cityVal].without++;
    if (isPaid(r)) {
      out[cityVal].paid++;
      var pAmt = getPaidAmount(r);
      out[cityVal].paidAmt += pAmt > 0 ? pAmt : amt;
    }
  });
  return Object.values(out);
}

function visibleCount(city) {
  let t = 0;
  if (activeFilters.with)    t += city.with;
  if (activeFilters.without) t += city.without;
  return t;
}
function grandTotal(cities) { return cities.reduce((s,c)=>s+visibleCount(c),0); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   DATE
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
// updateDate removed

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   RENDER SIDEBAR
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderSidebar(cities) {
  var totalAmt   = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.amount;},0);
  var totalLeads = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.with+c.without;},0);
  var totalPaid  = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paid;},0);
  var paidAmt    = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paidAmt;},0);
  var pendLeads  = totalLeads - totalPaid;
  var pendAmt    = totalAmt - paidAmt;

  // EP totals
  var epLeads = 0, epAmt = 0;
  (typeof getFilteredRows==="function"?getFilteredRows():rawRows).forEach(function(r){
    if (hasEvenPay(r)) {
      epLeads++;
      epAmt += parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0;
    }
  });

  // ── Score cards ──
  var ea = document.getElementById('lv-exp-amt');   if(ea) ea.textContent = fmtAmt(totalAmt);
  var ec = document.getElementById('lv-exp-count'); if(ec) ec.textContent = totalLeads+' leads';
  var pa = document.getElementById('lv-ep-amt');    if(pa) pa.textContent = fmtAmt(epAmt);
  var pc = document.getElementById('lv-ep-count');  if(pc) pc.textContent = epLeads+' even pay leads';
  var pna = document.getElementById('lv-pend-amt');   if(pna) pna.textContent = fmtAmt(pendAmt);
  var pnc = document.getElementById('lv-pend-count'); if(pnc) pnc.textContent = pendLeads+' pending';
  var adpFR=typeof getFilteredRows==='function'?getFilteredRows():rawRows;
  var adpRowsL=adpFR.filter(isAddedDuring),adpPaidL=adpRowsL.filter(isPaid);
  var adpAmtL=adpPaidL.reduce(function(s,r){var p=getPaidAmount(r);return s+(p>0?p:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0));},0);
  var adpElL=document.getElementById('lv-adp-amt');if(adpElL)adpElL.textContent=fmtAmt(adpAmtL);
  var adpCntL=document.getElementById('lv-adp-count');if(adpCntL)adpCntL.textContent=adpRowsL.length+' leads added · '+adpPaidL.length+' paid';
  var sub = document.getElementById('lv-title-sub'); if(sub) sub.textContent = totalLeads+' leads across all cities';

  // ── Zone breakdown ──
  _renderZoneLeft(cities);

  // ── City & IS breakdown ──
  var cityEl = document.getElementById('lv-city-breakdown');
  if (cityEl) {
    var zColors2 = {North:'#4a90d9', South:'#2ecc71', West:'#f5a623'};
    var sorted = [...cities].filter(function(c){return c.rows.length>0;})
      .sort(function(a,b){return b.amount-a.amount;});
    cityEl.innerHTML = sorted.map(function(city) {
      var col = zColors2[city.zone]||'#7a8099';
      // Get Owner names for this city
      var isMap = {};
      city.rows.forEach(function(r){
        var isName = r[C.OWNER]||r['Owner']||r['RM Full Name']||'Unknown';
        var leadName = (C.LEAD&&r[C.LEAD])||r['First Name']||r['Lead Name']||'—';
        var amt = parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0;
        var ep = hasEvenPay(r);
        if (!isMap[isName]) isMap[isName] = [];
        isMap[isName].push({lead:leadName, amt:amt, ep:ep});
      });
      var isHTML = Object.entries(isMap).sort(function(a,b){
        return b[1].reduce(function(s,x){return s+x.amt;},0)-a[1].reduce(function(s,x){return s+x.amt;},0);
      }).map(function(e){
        var isTotal = e[1].reduce(function(s,x){return s+x.amt;},0);
        return '<div style="margin-bottom:4px;">'
          +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:3px 6px;background:rgba(74,144,217,.06);border-radius:5px;margin-bottom:2px;">'
          +'<span style="font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);">'+e[0]+'</span>'
          +'<span style="font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;color:#4a90d9;">'+fmtAmt(isTotal)+' · '+e[1].length+' leads</span>'
          +'</div>'
          + e[1].map(function(l){
            return '<div class="tv-lead-row">'
              +'<span class="tv-lead-name">'+l.lead+'</span>'
              +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;">'
              +(l.ep?'<span class="tv-lead-ep">EP</span>':'')
              +'<span class="tv-lead-amt" style="margin-left:4px;">'+fmtAmt(l.amt)+'</span>'
              +'</div></div>';
          }).join('')
          +'</div>';
      }).join('');

            return '<div class="tv-city-row" data-cityname="'+city.name+'"'
        +'<div class="tv-city-header">'
        +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">'
        +'<div style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:'+col+';flex-shrink:0;"></div>'
        +'<span class="tv-city-name">'+city.name+'</span>'
        +'<span style="font-size:.62rem;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:'+col+'22;color:'+col+';">'+city.zone+'</span>'
        +'</div>'
        +'<span class="tv-city-amt">'+fmtAmt(city.amount)+'</span>'
        +'</div>'
        +'<div class="tv-city-leads">'+isHTML+'</div>'
        +'</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  // Keep hidden fields updated for filter logic compatibility
  var fcw = document.getElementById('fc-with');   if(fcw) fcw.textContent = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.with;},0);
  var fcwo = document.getElementById('fc-without'); if(fcwo) fcwo.textContent = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.without;},0);
  var tc = document.getElementById('totalCases'); if(tc) tc.textContent = totalLeads;

  // Click delegation for city rows
  var cityEl2 = document.getElementById('lv-city-breakdown');
  if (cityEl2) {
    cityEl2.onclick = function(e) {
      var row = e.target.closest('[data-cityname]');
      if (!row) return;
      var nm = row.getAttribute('data-cityname');
      var cs = buildCityData();
      var found = cs.find(function(c){return c.name===nm;});
      if (found) selectCity(found, cs);
    };
  }
}


function toggleSortPaid() {
  window._sortPaid = !window._sortPaid;
  var btn = document.getElementById('btn-sort-paid');
  if (btn) {
    btn.textContent = window._sortPaid ? '⇅ SORT: PAID' : '⇅ SORT: LEADS';
    btn.style.background   = window._sortPaid ? '#2ecc71' : 'var(--panel2)';
    btn.style.color        = window._sortPaid ? '#0a1f0d' : 'var(--muted)';
    btn.style.borderColor  = window._sortPaid ? '#2ecc71' : 'var(--border)';
  }
  renderAll();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MARKERS
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function placeMarkers(cities) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.marker').forEach(m=>m.remove());
  const mapEl = document.getElementById('mapImg');
  const area  = document.getElementById('mapArea');
  const rect  = mapEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const aRect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
  const offX  = rect.left - aRect.left;
  const offY  = rect.top  - aRect.top;
  const scX   = rect.width  / NAT_W;
  const scY   = rect.height / NAT_H;

  // Calculate raw positions
  const positions = cities.map(city => ({
    city,
    x: city.px * scX + offX,
    y: city.py * scY + offY,
  }));

  // Anti-overlap: push pins apart if they are within MIN_DIST px of each other
  const MIN_DIST = 30;
  const MAX_ITER = 20;
  for (let iter = 0; iter < MAX_ITER; iter++) {
    let moved = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < positions.length; j++) {
        const a = positions[i], b = positions[j];
        const dx = b.x - a.x, dy = b.y - a.y;
        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
        if (dist < MIN_DIST && dist > 0) {
          const push = (MIN_DIST - dist) / 2;
          const nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist;
          a.x -= nx * push; a.y -= ny * push;
          b.x += nx * push; b.y += ny * push;
          moved = true;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!moved) break;
  }

  // Render each marker with payment-based color
  positions.forEach(function(pos) { var city=pos.city, x=pos.x, y=pos.y;
    // 3-tier pin colors by paid amount
    var sortedP = Object.values(cities).filter(function(c){return c.paid>0;}).sort(function(a,b){return b.paidAmt-a.paidAmt;});
    var tmap={};
    sortedP.forEach(function(c,i){ tmap[c.name]=i<3?'high':i<6?'mid':'low'; });

    positions.forEach(function(pos) {
      var city=pos.city, x=pos.x, y=pos.y;
      var tier=tmap[city.name]||'low';
      var pc,ptc,pb;
      if(city.paid===0){pc='#4a5568';ptc='#cbd5e0';pb='#718096';}
      else if(tier==='high'){pc='#2ecc71';ptc='#0a1f0d';pb='#fff';}
      else if(tier==='mid'){pc='#f5a623';ptc='#1a0a00';pb='#fff';}
      else{pc='#e74c3c';ptc='#fff';pb='#fff';}
      var abg=city.paid===0?'rgba(74,85,104,.85)':tier==='high'?'rgba(46,204,113,.92)':tier==='mid'?'rgba(245,166,35,.92)':'rgba(231,76,60,.92)';
      var ac=tier==='high'?'#0a1f0d':'#fff';
      var tl=city.with+city.without;
      var lbl=city.name+(tl>0?' ('+tl+')':'');
      var below=city.paid>0?city.paid+' paid · '+fmtAmt(city.paidAmt):city.amount>0?fmtAmt(city.amount):'';
      var el=document.createElement('div');
      el.className='marker'+(selectedCity&&selectedCity.name===city.name?' active-mk':'');
      el.style.cssText='left:'+x+'px;top:'+y+'px;';
      el.innerHTML='<div class="pin-pulse" style="border-color:'+pc+';"></div>'
        +'<div class="pin-label" style="font-size:13px;font-weight:900;background:rgba(10,15,25,.88);">'+lbl+'</div>'
        +'<div class="pin-body" style="background:'+pc+';border-color:'+pb+';">'
        +'<span style="color:'+ptc+';font-weight:900;">'+city.name[0]+'</span></div>'
        +(below?'<div class="pin-amt" style="background:'+abg+';color:'+ac+';font-size:12px;font-weight:900;">'+below+'</div>':'');
      el.addEventListener('click',(function(c,cs){return function(){selectCity(c,cs);};})(city,cities));
      el.addEventListener('dblclick',(function(c){return function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var img=document.getElementById('mapImg'),ar=document.getElementById('mapArea');
        if(!img||!ar) return;
        var r2=img.getBoundingClientRect(),a2=ar.getBoundingClientRect();
        var cx=c.px*(r2.width/NAT_W)+(r2.left-a2.left);
        var cy=c.py*(r2.height/NAT_H)+(r2.top-a2.top);
        if(typeof _zoomAt==='function') _zoomAt(cx,cy,2.5);
      };})(city));
      area.appendChild(el);
    });
  });
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   SELECT CITY → RIGHT PANEL
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function selectCity(city, cities) {
  selectedCity = city;
  renderSidebar(cities);
  placeMarkers(cities);
  // Re-render drilldown if open
  var dd=document.getElementById('drilldown-sheet');
  if(dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0px)'||dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0%)'||dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0)') renderDrilldown();
  renderRightPanel(city);
}

function renderRightPanel(city) {
  if (!city) return;
  var tot=city.with+city.without;
  var withAmt=city.rows.filter(function(r){return hasEvenPay(r);}).reduce(function(s,r){return s+(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0);},0);
  var woAmt=city.rows.filter(function(r){return !hasEvenPay(r);}).reduce(function(s,r){return s+(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0);},0);
  var epPct=city.amount>0?Math.round(withAmt/city.amount*100):0;
  var cpRows=city.rows.filter(isPaid).sort(function(a,b){return getPaidAmount(b)-getPaidAmount(a);});
  var omap={};
  cpRows.forEach(function(r){
    var o=(r[C.OWNER]||r['Owner']||'Unknown').trim(),a=getPaidAmount(r);
    if(!omap[o])omap[o]={count:0,total:0};
    omap[o].count++;omap[o].total+=a;
  });
  var olist=Object.keys(omap).sort(function(a,b){return omap[b].total-omap[a].total;});
  var pdHTML=cpRows.length===0
    ?'<div style="text-align:center;padding:14px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem;">No paid leads yet</div>'
    :cpRows.map(function(r){
      var lead=(C.LEAD&&r[C.LEAD])||r['First Name']||'—';
      var owner=(r[C.OWNER]||r['Owner']||'').trim();
      var ep=hasEvenPay(r),amt=getPaidAmount(r);
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(46,204,113,.05);border:1px solid rgba(46,204,113,.15);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:4px;">'
        +'<div><div style="font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);">'+lead+'</div>'
        +(owner?'<div style="font-size:.66rem;color:var(--muted);">'+owner+'</div>':'')
        +'</div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;">'
        +(ep?'<span style="font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(46,204,113,.2);color:#2ecc71;">EP</span>':'')
        +'<span style="font-size:.85rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+fmtAmt(amt)+'</span></div></div>';
    }).join('');
  var ohHTML=olist.length===0?''
    :'<div style="margin-top:16px;"><div style="font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;">PAYMENTS BY OWNER</div>'
    +olist.map(function(o){
      var d=omap[o];
      return '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:7px 12px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:4px;">'
        +'<div style="font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);">'+o+'</div>'
        +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;"><span style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">'+d.count+' paid</span>'
        +'<span style="font-size:.82rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+fmtAmt(d.total)+'</span></div></div>';
    }).join('')+'</div>';
  document.getElementById('rightPanel').innerHTML=
    '<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:8px;">'
    +'<div><div class="city-title">'+city.name+'</div>'
    +'<div class="city-meta">'+city.zone+' Zone <span>|</span> '+tot+' leads <span>|</span> '+fmtAmt(city.amount)+'</div></div>'
    +'<button onclick="selectedCity=null;renderAll();" style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px;">✕ Return</button>'
    +'</div>'
    +'<div style="margin-bottom:12px;">'
    +'<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:5px;">EVEN PAY COMPOSITION</div>'
    +'<div style="height:6px;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--border);margin-bottom:6px;">'
    +'<div style="display:flex;height:100%;"><div style="width:'+epPct+'%;background:#2ecc71;transition:width .6s;"></div><div style="flex:1;background:#f5a623;"></div></div></div>'
    +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;">'
    +'<div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;"><div style="font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#2ecc71;margin-bottom:3px;">WITH EVEN PAY</div><div style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+city.with+'</div><div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">'+fmtAmt(withAmt)+'</div></div>'
    +'<div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;"><div style="font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f5a623;margin-bottom:3px;">WITHOUT EVEN PAY</div><div style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900;color:#f5a623;">'+city.without+'</div><div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">'+fmtAmt(woAmt)+'</div></div>'
    +'</div></div>'
    +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;">'
    +'<div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;"><div style="font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">TOTAL LEADS</div><div style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);">'+tot+'</div><div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">all statuses</div></div>'
    +'<div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;"><div style="font-size:.55rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">TOTAL AMOUNT</div><div style="font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);">'+fmtAmt(city.amount)+'</div><div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">expected</div></div>'
    +'</div>'
    +'<div style="font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:8px;">PAID DEALS</div>'
    +pdHTML+ohHTML;
}

function fmtAmt(n) {
  if (!n) return '₹0';
  if (n>=1e7) return '₹'+(n/1e7).toFixed(2)+' Cr';
  if (n>=1e5) return '₹'+(n/1e5).toFixed(2)+' L';
  if (n>=1000) return '₹'+(n/1000).toFixed(1)+'K';
  return '₹'+Math.round(n);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   RE-RENDER ALL
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function renderAll() {
  const cities = buildCityData();
  renderSidebar(cities);
  placeMarkers(cities);
  // Re-render drilldown if open
  var dd=document.getElementById('drilldown-sheet');
  if(dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0px)'||dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0%)'||dd&&dd.style.transform==='translateY(0)') renderDrilldown();
  if (showingAllCities) {
    showAllCitiesPanel();
  } else if (selectedCity) {
    const updated = cities.find(c=>c.name===selectedCity.name);
    if (updated) renderRightPanel(updated);
  } else {
    // Default: always show grand total summary on right panel
    showTotalSummary(cities);
  }
}

function setMode(m) {
  viewMode = m;
  document.getElementById('btnCount').classList.toggle('active', m==='count');
  document.getElementById('btnShare').classList.toggle('active', m==='share');
  renderAll();
}

function toggleFilter(key) {
  activeFilters[key] = !activeFilters[key];
  document.getElementById('fr-'+key).classList.toggle('active-filter', activeFilters[key]);
  renderAll();
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   UPDATE DATA PANEL
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function toggleDataPanel() {
  const panel = document.getElementById('data-panel');
  const btn   = document.getElementById('update-data-btn');
  const open  = panel.classList.toggle('visible');
  btn.classList.toggle('open', open);
  if (open) document.getElementById('paste-area').focus();
}

function applyPastedData() {
  const raw = document.getElementById('paste-area').value.trim();
  const status = document.getElementById('data-status');
  if (!raw) { status.className='data-status err'; status.textContent='⚠ Nothing pasted yet.'; return; }

  const sep = raw.split('\n')[0].includes('\t') ? '\t' : ',';
  const lines = raw.split(/\r?\n/).filter(l=>l.trim());
  if (lines.length < 2) { status.className='data-status err'; status.textContent='⚠ Need at least a header row + one data row.'; return; }

  headers = splitLine(lines[0], sep).map(h=>h.trim());
  resolveColumns(headers);
  rawRows = lines.slice(1).map(l => {
    const cells = splitLine(l, sep);
    const o = {};
    headers.forEach((h,i) => o[h] = (cells[i]||'').trim());
    return o;
  }).filter(r => {
    const vals = Object.values(r).filter(v=>v&&v!=='—'&&v!=='-');
    return vals.length > 0;
  });

  if (!rawRows.length) { status.className='data-status err'; status.textContent='⚠ No valid data rows found.'; return; }

  // Build a human-readable column map summary
  var paidCount = rawRows.filter(isPaid).length;
  var epCount   = rawRows.filter(hasEvenPay).length;

  var paidTotalAmt = rawRows.filter(isPaid).reduce(function(s,r){ var p=getPaidAmount(r); return s+(p>0?p:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0)); }, 0);
  function fmtD(n){ if(!n)return'₹0'; if(n>=1e5)return'₹'+(n/1e5).toFixed(2)+' L'; if(n>=1000)return'₹'+(n/1000).toFixed(1)+'K'; return'₹'+Math.round(n); }
  status.className='data-status ok';
  status.innerHTML = '✓ '+rawRows.length+' rows loaded'
    + '<br/>📍 City: <b>'+(C.CITY||'NOT FOUND')+'</b>'
    + ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; 💰 Amount: <b>'+(C.AMOUNT||'NOT FOUND')+'</b>'
    + ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; 💳 Paid col: <b>'+(C.PAID_AMT||'scanning')+'</b>'
    + '<br/>✅ Even Pay: <b>'+epCount+'</b>'
    + ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; 💵 Paid leads: <b>'+paidCount+'</b>'
    + ' &nbsp;·&nbsp; 💰 Paid total: <b>'+fmtD(paidTotalAmt)+'</b>';

  setTimeout(()=>{
    document.getElementById('data-panel').classList.remove('visible');
    document.getElementById('update-data-btn').classList.remove('open');
  }, 1400);

  renderAll();
}

function splitLine(line, sep) {
  if (sep !== ',') return line.split(sep);
  const result=[]; let cur='', inQ=false;
  for (let i=0; i<=line.length; i++) {
    const c = line[i];
    if (i===line.length) { result.push(cur.replace(/^"|"$/g,'')); break; }
    if (c==='"') { inQ=!inQ; }
    else if (c===sep&&!inQ) { result.push(cur.replace(/^"|"$/g,'')); cur=''; }
    else cur+=c;
  }
  return result;
}
