/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   DEFAULT RIGHT PANEL — TOTAL SUMMARY
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function showTotalSummary(cities) {
  if (!cities) cities = buildCityData();
  var totalAmt     = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.amount;},0);
  var totalLeads   = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.with+c.without;},0);
  var totalPaid    = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paid;},0);
  var totalPaidAmt = cities.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paidAmt;},0);
  var collPct      = totalAmt > 0 ? Math.round(totalPaidAmt/totalAmt*100) : 0;

  // EP paid
  var paidRows    = (typeof getFilteredRows==="function"?getFilteredRows():rawRows).filter(isPaid);
  var adpRowsR=(typeof getFilteredRows==='function'?getFilteredRows():rawRows).filter(isAddedDuring);
  var adpPaidR=adpRowsR.filter(isPaid);
  var adpAmtR=adpPaidR.reduce(function(s,r){var p=getPaidAmount(r);return s+(p>0?p:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0));},0);
  var epPaidRows  = paidRows.filter(hasEvenPay);
  var epPaidAmt   = epPaidRows.reduce(function(s,r){var p=getPaidAmount(r);return s+(p>0?p:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0));},0);
  var clinPaidAmt = totalPaidAmt - epPaidAmt;

  var zoneHTML = _buildZoneHTML(cities);
  var zColors = {North:'#4a90d9', South:'#2ecc71', West:'#f5a623'};

  // Paid by city
  var paidByCity = {};
  paidRows.forEach(function(r){
    var _city = r[C.CITY]||r['RM City']||r['Clinic City']||'';
    if(!_city) Object.keys(r).forEach(function(k){if(!_city&&k.toLowerCase().indexOf('city')>=0)_city=r[k];});
    _city=_city.trim(); if(!_city) return;
    if(!paidByCity[_city]) paidByCity[_city]={rows:[],amt:0};
    var p=getPaidAmount(r);
    paidByCity[_city].rows.push(r);
    paidByCity[_city].amt += p>0?p:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0);
  });

  var cityPaidHTML = '';
  var sortedCities = Object.entries(paidByCity).sort(function(a,b){return b[1].amt-a[1].amt;});
  if (sortedCities.length === 0) {
    cityPaidHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:24px 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.82rem;opacity:.6;">No paid leads yet</div>';
  } else {
    sortedCities.forEach(function(e){
      var cname=e[0], cd=e[1];
      var zone=''; CITY_CONFIG.forEach(function(c){if(c.name.toLowerCase()===cname.toLowerCase())zone=c.zone;});
      var col = zColors[zone]||'#2ecc71';
      cityPaidHTML += '<div class="tv-paid-city-row">'
        +'<div class="tv-paid-city-hdr">'
        +'<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">'
        +'<div style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:'+col+';flex-shrink:0;"></div>'
        +'<span class="tv-paid-city-name">'+cname+'</span>'
        +'<span style="font-size:.6rem;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:'+col+'22;color:'+col+';">'+cd.rows.length+' paid</span>'
        +'</div>'
        +'<span class="tv-paid-city-total">'+fmtAmt(cd.amt)+'</span>'
        +'</div>'
        + cd.rows.map(function(r){
            var lead=(C.LEAD&&r[C.LEAD])||r['First Name']||r['Lead Name']||'—';
            var owner=r[C.OWNER]||r['Owner']||'';
            var ep=hasEvenPay(r);
            var pa=getPaidAmount(r); var amt=pa>0?pa:(parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0);
            return '<div class="tv-paid-lead-item">'
              +'<div><div class="tv-paid-lead-name">'+lead+'</div>'
              +(owner?'<div style="font-size:.62rem;color:var(--muted);">'+owner+'</div>':'')+'</div>'
              +'<div class="tv-paid-lead-right">'
              +(ep?'<span class="tv-paid-lead-ep">EP</span>':'')
              +'<span class="tv-paid-lead-amt">'+fmtAmt(amt)+'</span>'
              +'</div></div>';
          }).join('')
        +'</div>';
    });
  }

  // Conversion % = (paid leads / total leads) * 100
  var convPct = totalLeads > 0 ? Math.round(totalPaid/totalLeads*100) : 0;

  document.getElementById('rightPanel').innerHTML =
    // ── Section title ──
    '<div style="flex-shrink:0;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border);">'
    +'<div style="font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text);">TOTAL PAYMENTS</div>'
    +'<div style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:.04em;">Live collection tracker &nbsp;·&nbsp; '+totalPaid+' payments received</div>'
    +'</div>'

    // ── Card 1: Total Paid (mirrors PAYMENT EXPECTED on left) ──
    +'<div class="tv-paid-card total">'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-label">TOTAL PAID TODAY</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-amount">'+fmtAmt(totalPaidAmt)+'</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-sub">'+totalPaid+' payments &nbsp;·&nbsp; '+collPct+'% of expected</div>'
    +'</div>'

    // ── Card 2: Even Pay Paid (mirrors EVEN PAY EXPECTED on left) ──
    +'<div class="tv-paid-card ep">'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-label">EVEN PAY PAID</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-amount">'+fmtAmt(epPaidAmt)+'</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-sub">'+epPaidRows.length+' ep payments</div>'
    +'</div>'

    // ── Card 3: Conversion % (mirrors PENDING on left) ──
    +'<div class="tv-paid-card clinic">'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-label">CONVERSION RATE</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-amount">'+convPct+'%</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-sub">'+fmtAmt(clinPaidAmt)+' clinic &nbsp;·&nbsp; '+(totalPaid-epPaidRows.length)+' payments</div>'
    // mini bar
    +'</div>'

    +'<div class="tv-paid-card adp">'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-label">ADDED DURING DAY</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-amount">'+fmtAmt(adpAmtR)+'</div>'
    +'<div class="tv-paid-sub">'+adpRowsR.length+' leads added · '+adpPaidR.length+' paid</div>'
    +'</div>'
    +'<div style="flex-shrink:0;">'
    +'<div style="margin-top:10px;">'
    +zoneHTML
    +'</div>'

    // PAID BY CITY removed;
}


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   ALL CITIES TOTAL VIEW
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function toggleAllCities() {
  showingAllCities = !showingAllCities;
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn-all-cities');
  if (showingAllCities) {
    btn.style.background = '#2ecc71';
    btn.style.color = '#fff';
    btn.style.borderColor = '#2ecc71';
    showAllCitiesPanel();
  } else {
    btn.style.background = 'var(--panel2)';
    btn.style.color = 'var(--muted)';
    btn.style.borderColor = 'var(--border)';
    renderAll();
  }
}

function showAllCitiesPanel() {
  const cities = buildCityData();
  const totalWith    = cities.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.with, 0);
  const totalWithout = cities.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.without, 0);
  const totalAmt     = cities.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.amount, 0);
  const totalLeads   = totalWith + totalWithout;
  const sorted       = [...cities].sort((a,b)=>(b.with+b.without)-(a.with+a.without));

  // Right panel — show grand total summary
  document.getElementById('rightPanel').innerHTML = `
    <div>
      <div class="city-title" style="font-size:1.2rem;">All Cities — Total</div>
      <div class="city-meta">3 Zones &nbsp;|&nbsp; ${sorted.length} Cities &nbsp;|&nbsp; ${fmtAmt(totalAmt)}</div>
    </div>
    <div>
      <div class="comp-label">Even Pay Composition</div>
      <div class="comp-bar">
        <div style="flex:${totalWith||1};background:var(--green)"></div>
        <div style="flex:${totalWithout||1};background:var(--orange)"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-grid">
      <div class="stat-card green-card">
        <div class="slabel">EVEN PAY LEADS</div>
        <div class="sval">${totalWith}</div>
        <div class="spct">${totalLeads?Math.round(totalWith/totalLeads*100):0}% of total</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card orange-card">
        <div class="slabel">CLINIC LEADS</div>
        <div class="sval">${totalWithout}</div>
        <div class="spct">${totalLeads?Math.round(totalWithout/totalLeads*100):0}% of total</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card white-card">
        <div class="slabel">Total Leads</div>
        <div class="sval">${totalLeads}</div>
        <div class="spct">all cities</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card white-card">
        <div class="slabel">Total Amount</div>
        <div class="sval" style="font-size:1.1rem">${fmtAmt(totalAmt)}</div>
        <div class="spct">expected</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="section-label" style="margin-top:4px;">City Breakdown</div>
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;overflow-y:auto;max-height:240px;">
      ${sorted.map((c,i) => {
        const t = c.with + c.without;
        const barW = totalLeads ? Math.round(t/totalLeads*100) : 0;
        const zoneColor = c.zone==='North'?'#4a90d9':c.zone==='South'?'#2ecc71':'#f5a623';
        return `<div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;">
          <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">
            <div>
              <span style="font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)">${i+1}. ${c.name}</span>
              <span style="font-size:.63rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:4px;margin-left:6px;background:${zoneColor}22;color:${zoneColor}">${c.zone}</span>
            </div>
            <span style="font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text)">${t} leads</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;font-size:.68rem;color:var(--muted);">
            <span style="color:var(--green)">✓ ${c.with} Even Pay</span>
            <span style="color:var(--orange)">✗ ${c.without} Clinic</span>
            <span>${fmtAmt(c.amount)}</span>
          </div>
          <div style="height:3px;background:var(--border);border-radius:2px;margin-top:6px;overflow:hidden;">
            <div style="width:${barW}%;height:100%;background:${zoneColor};border-radius:2px;"></div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('')}
    </div>`;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   FETCH HINT
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function showFetchHint() {
  // Show a subtle hint in the right panel only if no data loaded yet
  if (rawRows.length > 0) return;
  document.getElementById('rightPanel').innerHTML = `
    <div style="margin:auto;text-align:center;padding:20px 16px;">
      <div style="font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:10px;">📋</div>
      <div style="font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:8px;">No data loaded yet</div>
      <div style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:16px;">
        Click <strong style="color:var(--green)">Update Data</strong> in the top-right<br/>
        to paste your Google Sheet data.
      </div>
      <div style="background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;">
        <strong style="color:var(--orange)">How to paste:</strong><br/>
        1. Open your Google Sheet<br/>
        2. Select All → Ctrl+C<br/>
        3. Click Update Data → Paste → Apply
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   INIT
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
const mapImg = document.getElementById('mapImg');
/* ═══ GLOBALS ═══ */
var _calMode='day', _calYear=new Date().getFullYear(), _calMonth=new Date().getMonth();
var _filterISO='', _calOpen=false;
var _zoneChartMode={North:'day',South:'day',West:'day'};
var _zoneChartOffset={North:0,South:0,West:0};
var _zoneChartTip={};
var _lastRefreshTime=null;

/* ═══ DATE PARSE ═══ */
function parseDate(raw) {
  raw=String(raw||'').trim();
  var m=raw.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/);
  if(m){if(+m[1]>12)return new Date(+m[3],+m[2]-1,+m[1],12);if(+m[2]>12)return new Date(+m[3],+m[1]-1,+m[2],12);return new Date(+m[3],+m[2]-1,+m[1],12);}
  var m2=raw.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/);if(m2)return new Date(+m2[1],+m2[2]-1,+m2[3],12);
  var d=new Date(raw);if(!isNaN(d)){d.setHours(12,0,0,0);}return isNaN(d)?null:d;
}
function isAddedDuring(r){
  var pv='';
  if(C.POD&&r[C.POD])pv=String(r[C.POD]).toLowerCase().trim();
  else Object.keys(r).forEach(function(k){if(k.toLowerCase().indexOf('pod')>=0)pv=String(r[k]).toLowerCase().trim();});
  return pv.indexOf('added')>=0;
}

/* ═══ CALENDAR ═══ */
function toggleCalendar(){_calOpen=!_calOpen;var p=document.getElementById('cal-popup');if(p)p.style.display=_calOpen?'block':'none';if(_calOpen)renderCalendar();}
function closeCalendar(){_calOpen=false;var p=document.getElementById('cal-popup');if(p)p.style.display='none';}
function setCalMode(m){_calMode=m;['day','week','month'].forEach(function(x){var b=document.getElementById('cal-mode-'+x);if(!b)return;b.style.background=x===m?'var(--green)':'var(--panel2)';b.style.color=x===m?'#0f1117':'var(--muted)';});renderCalendar();}
function calNav(d){_calMonth+=d;if(_calMonth>11){_calMonth=0;_calYear++;}if(_calMonth<0){_calMonth=11;_calYear--;}renderCalendar();}
function clearDateFilter(){_filterISO='';var l=document.getElementById('cal-label');if(l)l.textContent='All Dates';closeCalendar();renderAll();setTimeout(autoFocusMap,150);}
function getDataDates(){var dc=headers.find(function(h){return h.toLowerCase().trim()==='expected closure date';})||headers[0];var s={};rawRows.forEach(function(r){var d=parseDate(r[dc]);if(d&&!isNaN(d)&&d.getFullYear()>=2020)s[d.toISOString().slice(0,10)]=true;});return s;}
function getISOWeek(d){var dt=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate()));var dn=dt.getUTCDay()||7;dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate()+4-dn);var ys=new Date(Date.UTC(dt.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));return[dt.getUTCFullYear(),Math.ceil((((dt-ys)/86400000)+1)/7)];}
function renderCalendar(){
  var mn=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  var l=document.getElementById('cal-month-label');if(l)l.textContent=mn[_calMonth]+' '+_calYear;
  var g=document.getElementById('cal-grid');if(!g)return;g.innerHTML='';
  var dd=rawRows.length?getDataDates():{};
  var fd=new Date(_calYear,_calMonth,1).getDay(),dim=new Date(_calYear,_calMonth+1,0).getDate();
  var ti=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  for(var i=0;i<fd;i++)g.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
  for(var day=1;day<=dim;day++){
    var d2=new Date(_calYear,_calMonth,day,12),iso=d2.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    var wk=getISOWeek(d2),wkk='week:'+wk[0]+'-W'+(wk[1]<10?'0'+wk[1]:wk[1]);
    var mk='month:'+_calYear+'-'+(_calMonth<9?'0':'')+(_calMonth+1);
    var hd=!!dd[iso];
    var isA=(_calMode==='day'&&_filterISO===iso)||(_calMode==='week'&&_filterISO===wkk)||(_calMode==='month'&&_filterISO===mk);
    var isT=iso===ti;
    var c=document.createElement('div');c.textContent=day;
    c.style.cssText='text-align:center;padding:5px 2px;border-radius:6px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:'+(hd?'800':'400')+';cursor:'+(hd?'pointer':'default')+';color:'+(isA?'#0f1117':hd?'var(--text)':'var(--muted)')+';background:'+(isA?'var(--green)':isT?'rgba(46,204,113,.15)':'transparent')+';border:1px solid '+(isT&&!isA?'var(--green)':'transparent')+';opacity:'+(hd?'1':'.35');
    if(hd){(function(di,wk2,mk2){c.onclick=function(){if(_calMode==='day')_filterISO=di;else if(_calMode==='week')_filterISO=wk2;else _filterISO=mk2;updateCalLabel();closeCalendar();renderAll();};})(iso,wkk,mk);}
    g.appendChild(c);
  }
}
function updateCalLabel(){var l=document.getElementById('cal-label');if(!l)return;if(!_filterISO){l.textContent='All Dates';return;}if(_filterISO.indexOf('week:')===0){l.textContent=_filterISO.replace('week:','')+' (Week)';return;}if(_filterISO.indexOf('month:')===0){var p=_filterISO.replace('month:','').split('-');l.textContent=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][parseInt(p[1])-1]+' '+p[0];return;}var d=new Date(_filterISO);l.textContent=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()]+', '+d.getDate()+' '+['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()];}
function getFilteredRows(){if(!_filterISO||!rawRows.length)return rawRows;var dc=headers.find(function(h){return h.toLowerCase().trim()==='expected closure date';})||headers[0];return rawRows.filter(function(r){var d=parseDate(r[dc]);if(!d||isNaN(d)||d.getFullYear()<2020)return false;var iso=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);if(_filterISO.indexOf('week:')===0){var wk=getISOWeek(d),k='week:'+wk[0]+'-W'+(wk[1]<10?'0'+wk[1]:wk[1]);return k===_filterISO;}if(_filterISO.indexOf('month:')===0)return('month:'+iso.slice(0,7))===_filterISO;return iso===_filterISO;});}
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(!_calOpen)return;var p=document.getElementById('cal-popup'),b=document.getElementById('cal-btn');if(p&&b&&!p.contains(e.target)&&!b.contains(e.target))closeCalendar();});

/* ═══ SHEET + REFRESH ═══ */
function toggleSheetPanel(){var p=document.getElementById('sheet-panel');if(p)p.classList.toggle('visible');}
function triggerRefresh(){var b=document.getElementById('refresh-btn');if(b){b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Loading\u2026';}loadSheet();}
function loadSheet(){
  var URL='https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyLTE0qLX8IBflr6my9UWj8CthQWpx3WN19uebevqT3DVgtJJ6T2t6NWoFUvtJwx5tW/exec';
  var b=document.getElementById('refresh-btn');
  if(b){b.disabled=true;b.textContent='Loading…';}

  function done(j){
    if(b){b.disabled=false;b.textContent='↻ Refresh';}
    if(!j||!j.ok||!j.rows||!j.rows.length){fail();return;}
    headers=Object.keys(j.rows[0]);resolveColumns(headers);rawRows=j.rows;
    renderAll();
    setTimeout(function(){autoFocusMap();},100);
    var t=new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
    var rt=document.getElementById('last-refresh-time');
    if(rt){rt.textContent='Last updated: '+t+' · '+j.count+' rows';rt.style.color='var(--muted)';}
    _lastRefreshTime=new Date();
  }

  function fail(){
    if(b){b.disabled=false;b.textContent='↻ Refresh';}
    var rt=document.getElementById('last-refresh-time');
    if(rt&&_lastRefreshTime){
      var t=_lastRefreshTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});
      var diff=Math.round((new Date()-_lastRefreshTime)/60000);
      rt.textContent='Last updated: '+t+(diff>0?' ('+diff+'m ago)':'');
    } else if(rt) rt.textContent='Not connected';
  }

  // Try JSONP first (handles CORS)
  var cb='_gsCB'+Date.now(), settled=false;
  function settle(){ settled=true; delete window[cb]; var s=document.getElementById('_gsTag'); if(s)s.remove(); }

  window[cb]=function(j){ if(settled)return; settle(); done(j); };

  // Timeout — if JSONP doesn't fire in 6s, try plain fetch
  var timer=setTimeout(function(){
    if(settled)return; settle();
    fetch(URL,{mode:'cors'})
      .then(function(r){return r.json();})
      .then(done)
      .catch(fail);
  }, 6000);

  var old=document.getElementById('_gsTag'); if(old)old.remove();
  var sc=document.createElement('script');
  sc.id='_gsTag';
  sc.src=URL+'?callback='+cb;
  sc.onload=function(){ clearTimeout(timer); };
  sc.onerror=function(){
    if(settled)return; settle(); clearTimeout(timer);
    fetch(URL,{mode:'cors'})
      .then(function(r){return r.json();})
      .then(done)
      .catch(fail);
  };
  document.head.appendChild(sc);
}
setInterval(function(){loadSheet();},5*60*1000);
setInterval(function(){var rt=document.getElementById('last-refresh-time');if(!rt||!_lastRefreshTime)return;var diff=Math.round((new Date()-_lastRefreshTime)/60000);var t=_lastRefreshTime.toLocaleTimeString('en-IN',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'});rt.textContent='Last updated: '+t+(diff>0?' ('+diff+'m ago)':'');},30*1000);

/* ═══ DRILLDOWN ═══ */
function openDrilldown(){var s=document.getElementById('drilldown-sheet');if(s)s.style.transform='translateY(0)';renderDrilldown();}
function closeDrilldown(){var s=document.getElementById('drilldown-sheet');if(s)s.style.transform='translateY(100%)';}
function renderDrilldown(){
  var cities=buildCityData(), ca=Object.values(cities);
  var zones={North:[], West:[], South:[]};
  ca.forEach(function(c){ if(zones[c.zone]) zones[c.zone].push(c); });
  var sub=document.getElementById('dd-subtitle'), fr=getFilteredRows();
  if(sub){ var cl=(document.getElementById('cal-label')||{}).textContent||'All dates'; sub.textContent=fr.length+' leads \u00b7 '+cl; }

  var zColors={North:'#4a90d9', West:'#f5a623', South:'#2ecc71'};
  var zOrder=['North','West','South'];

  zOrder.forEach(function(zone){
    var el=document.getElementById('dd-'+zone.toLowerCase()); if(!el) return;
    var col=zColors[zone];
    var cs=zones[zone].sort(function(a,b){ return b.paidAmt-a.paidAmt; });

    var zExp  = cs.reduce(function(s,c){ return s+c.amount;},0);
    var zRec  = cs.reduce(function(s,c){ return s+c.paidAmt;},0);
    var zPend = zExp-zRec;
    var zL    = cs.reduce(function(s,c){ return s+c.with+c.without;},0);
    var zPaid = cs.reduce(function(s,c){ return s+c.paid;},0);
    var zCv   = zL>0?Math.round(zPaid/zL*100):0;
    var best  = cs.length?cs[0].name:'\u2014';

    function miniCard(label, labelCol, amount, sub2){
      return '<div style="background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;">'
        +'<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.10em;color:'+labelCol+';margin-bottom:4px;">'+label+'</div>'
        +'<div style="font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;">'+amount+'</div>'
        +'<div style="font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;">'+sub2+'</div>'
        +'</div>';
    }

    var h = ''
      +'<div style="padding:14px 14px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid '+col+'44;">'
      +  '<div style="font-size:.72rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:'+col+';margin-bottom:10px;">'+zone+' Zone</div>'
      +  '<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;">'
      +    miniCard('Expected', '#4a90d9', fmtAmt(zExp), zL+' leads')
      +    miniCard('Received', '#2ecc71', fmtAmt(zRec), zPaid+' payments')
      +    miniCard('Pending',  '#f5a623', fmtAmt(zPend), (zL-zPaid)+' pending')
      +    miniCard('Conv %',   col,       zCv+'%', 'Best: '+best)
      +  '</div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'<div style="padding:10px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;">';

    cs.forEach(function(c, idx){
      var tot  = c.with+c.without;
      var pend = tot-c.paid;
      var cv   = tot>0?Math.round(c.paid/tot*100):0;
      var medals = ['\ud83c\udfc6','\ud83e\udd48','\ud83e\udd49','\ud83c\udf96'];
      var rank = idx < medals.length ? medals[idx] : (idx+1)+'.';
      var isBest = idx===0;
      h += '<div style="background:var(--panel);border:2px solid '+(isBest?col:'var(--border)')+';border-radius:12px;padding:10px 12px;">'
        +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;">'
        +  '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">'
        +    '<span style="font-size:1rem;">'+rank+'</span>'
        +    '<span style="font-size:.9rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);">'+c.name+'</span>'
        +  '</div>'
        +  '<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:20px;background:'+col+'22;color:'+col+';">'+cv+'% conv</span>'
        +'</div>'
        +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;">'
        +  '<div style="text-align:center;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 4px;">'
        +    '<div style="font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);">'+tot+'</div>'
        +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;">Leads</div>'
        +  '</div>'
        +  '<div style="text-align:center;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 4px;">'
        +    '<div style="font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+c.paid+'</div>'
        +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;">Paid</div>'
        +  '</div>'
        +  '<div style="text-align:center;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 4px;">'
        +    '<div style="font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:900;color:#f5a623;">'+pend+'</div>'
        +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;">Pending</div>'
        +  '</div>'
        +'</div>'
        +'<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'
        +  '<span style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">'+fmtAmt(c.paidAmt)+' collected</span>'
        +  '<span style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--muted);">'+fmtAmt(c.amount)+' expected</span>'
        +'</div>'
        +'</div>';
    });

    h += '</div>';
    _zoneChartOffset[zone]=Math.max(0,buildZoneDailyData(zone).length-7);
    h+='<div id="dd-chart-'+zone.toLowerCase()+'" style="border-top:1px solid var(--border);"></div>';
    el.innerHTML=h;
    (function(z){ setTimeout(function(){ renderZoneChart(z,_zoneChartOffset[z]||0); },0); })(zone);
  });
}

/* ═══ ZONE CHARTS ═══ */
function buildZoneDailyData(zone){
  var dc=headers.find(function(h){return h.toLowerCase().trim()==='expected closure date';})||headers[0];
  var dt={};
  rawRows.forEach(function(r){
    var cv=(r[C.CITY]||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    var cf=CITY_CONFIG.find(function(c){return c.name.toLowerCase()===cv;});
    if(!cf||cf.zone!==zone)return;
    var d=parseDate(r[dc]);
    if(!d||isNaN(d)||d.getFullYear()<2020)return;
    var iso=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    if(!dt[iso])dt[iso]={count:0,amt:0,expected:0};
    var exp=parseFloat(String(r[C.AMOUNT]||'').replace(/[^0-9.-]/g,''))||0;
    dt[iso].expected+=exp;
    var p=getPaidAmount(r);
    if(p>0){dt[iso].count++;dt[iso].amt+=p;}
  });
  return Object.keys(dt).sort().map(function(iso){return{iso:iso,count:dt[iso].count,amt:dt[iso].amt,expected:dt[iso].expected};});
}
function buildZoneMonthlyData(zone){var m2={};buildZoneDailyData(zone).forEach(function(d){var k=d.iso.slice(0,7);if(!m2[k])m2[k]={key:k,count:0,amt:0};m2[k].count+=d.count;m2[k].amt+=d.amt;});return Object.keys(m2).sort().map(function(k){return m2[k];});}
function renderZoneChart(zone,offset){
  var el=document.getElementById('dd-chart-'+zone.toLowerCase());if(!el)return;
  var col={North:'#4a90d9',West:'#f5a623',South:'#2ecc71'}[zone];
  var mode=_zoneChartMode[zone]||'day';
  var data=mode==='month'?buildZoneMonthlyData(zone):buildZoneDailyData(zone);
  if(!data.length){el.innerHTML='<div style="text-align:center;padding:12px;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted);">No data</div>';return;}
  var ws=mode==='month'?6:7;
  offset=Math.max(0,Math.min(offset,Math.max(0,data.length-ws)));
  _zoneChartOffset[zone]=offset;
  var slice=data.slice(offset,offset+ws);
  while(slice.length<ws)slice.push({iso:'',key:'',count:0,amt:0});
  var maxC=Math.max(1,Math.max.apply(null,slice.map(function(d){return d.count;})));
  var tipI=_zoneChartTip[zone];
  var mn=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  function fd(iso){if(!iso)return'';var p=iso.split('-');return p[2]+' '+mn[parseInt(p[1])-1];}
  function fm(key){if(!key)return'';var p=key.split('-');return mn[parseInt(p[1])-1]+' '+p[0];}
  var canP=offset>0,canN=offset+ws<data.length;
  el.innerHTML='';
  var hdr=document.createElement('div');hdr.style.cssText='display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 12px 5px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);';
  var mb=document.createElement('div');mb.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:4px;';
  ['day','month'].forEach(function(m){var b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=m==='day'?'Day':'Month';b.style.cssText='padding:3px 9px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);font-size:.6rem;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;background:'+(mode===m?col:'var(--panel2)')+';color:'+(mode===m?'#0f1117':'var(--muted)');b.dataset.zone=zone;b.dataset.mode=m;b.addEventListener('click',function(){setZoneChartMode(this.dataset.zone,this.dataset.mode);});mb.appendChild(b);});
  var nb=document.createElement('div');nb.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:3px;';
  var bp=document.createElement('button');bp.innerHTML='&#8249;';bp.style.cssText='width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel2);color:'+(canP?'var(--text)':'var(--border)')+';cursor:'+(canP?'pointer':'default')+';font-size:.75rem;';if(canP){bp.dataset.zone=zone;bp.dataset.delta=String(-ws);bp.addEventListener('click',function(){scrollZoneChart(this.dataset.zone,parseInt(this.dataset.delta));});}
  var bn=document.createElement('button');bn.innerHTML='&#8250;';bn.style.cssText='width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel2);color:'+(canN?'var(--text)':'var(--border)')+';cursor:'+(canN?'pointer':'default')+';font-size:.75rem;';if(canN){bn.dataset.zone=zone;bn.dataset.delta=String(ws);bn.addEventListener('click',function(){scrollZoneChart(this.dataset.zone,parseInt(this.dataset.delta));});}
  nb.appendChild(bp);nb.appendChild(bn);hdr.appendChild(mb);hdr.appendChild(nb);el.appendChild(hdr);
  if(tipI!==undefined&&slice[tipI]&&slice[tipI].count>0){var tip=slice[tipI];var te=document.createElement('div');te.style.cssText='margin:0 12px 5px;padding:6px 10px;background:'+col+'18;border:1px solid '+col+'44;border-radius:7px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;';te.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:'+col+';">'+(mode==='month'?fm(tip.key):fd(tip.iso))+'</span><span style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text);font-weight:700;">'+tip.count+' paid \u00b7 '+fmtAmt(tip.amt)+'</span>';el.appendChild(te);}
  // Check if single day filter active
  var isSingleDay = _filterISO && _filterISO.indexOf(':')===(-1) && _filterISO.length===10;
  var maxExpected = Math.max(1, Math.max.apply(null, slice.map(function(d){ return d.expected||0; })));
  var maxVal = Math.max(maxC, isSingleDay ? maxExpected : 0);
  maxC = Math.max(maxC, isSingleDay ? maxExpected : 0);

  var br=document.createElement('div');br.style.cssText='display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;padding:0 12px;height:140px;';
  slice.forEach(function(d,i){var bh=d.count>0?Math.max(8,Math.round(d.count/maxC*128)):3,sel=tipI===i;var bw=document.createElement('div');bw.style.cssText='flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:2px;cursor:'+(d.count>0?'pointer':'default');if(d.count>0){bw.dataset.zone=zone;bw.dataset.idx=String(i);bw.addEventListener('click',function(){selectZoneBar(this.dataset.zone,parseInt(this.dataset.idx));});}var lbl=document.createElement('span');lbl.textContent=d.count>0?d.count:'';lbl.style.cssText='font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;color:'+col+';min-height:10px;';var bar=document.createElement('div');bar.style.cssText='width:100%;height:'+bh+'px;background:'+col+';border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;opacity:'+(d.count>0?(sel?'1':'.65'):'0.12')+(sel?';box-shadow:0 0 0 2px '+col:'');bw.appendChild(lbl);bw.appendChild(bar);br.appendChild(bw);});
  el.appendChild(br);
  if(mode==='day'){var lr=document.createElement('div');lr.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:3px;padding:3px 12px 10px;';slice.forEach(function(d){var l2=document.createElement('div');l2.textContent=fd(d.iso);l2.style.cssText='flex:1;text-align:center;font-size:.5rem;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;';lr.appendChild(l2);});el.appendChild(lr);}else{var sp=document.createElement('div');sp.style.height='8px';el.appendChild(sp);}
}
function selectZoneBar(zone,idx){_zoneChartTip[zone]=(_zoneChartTip[zone]===idx)?undefined:idx;renderZoneChart(zone,_zoneChartOffset[zone]||0);}
function setZoneChartMode(zone,mode){_zoneChartMode[zone]=mode;_zoneChartOffset[zone]=Math.max(0,(mode==='month'?buildZoneMonthlyData(zone):buildZoneDailyData(zone)).length-(mode==='month'?6:7));_zoneChartTip[zone]=undefined;renderZoneChart(zone,_zoneChartOffset[zone]);}
function scrollZoneChart(zone,delta){renderZoneChart(zone,(_zoneChartOffset[zone]||0)+delta);}

/* ═══ ZONE LEFT PANEL + ADP ═══ */
function _renderZoneLeft(cities){
  var zEl=document.getElementById('lv-zone-breakdown');if(!zEl)return;
  var zColors={North:'#4a90d9',South:'#2ecc71',West:'#f5a623'};
  zEl.innerHTML=['North','South','West'].map(function(zone){
    var zc    = cities.filter(function(c){return c.zone===zone;});
    var col   = zColors[zone]||'#7a8099';
    var zAmt  = zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.amount;},0);
    var zPaid = zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paidAmt;},0);
    var zLeads= zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.with+c.without;},0);
    var zEP   = zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.with;},0);
    var zADP  = zc.reduce(function(s,c){
      return s+c.rows.filter(function(r){return typeof isAddedDuring==='function'&&isAddedDuring(r);}).length;
    },0);
    var barW = zAmt>0 ? Math.min(100,Math.round(zPaid/zAmt*100)) : 0;
    return '<div class="tv-zone-row" style="border-color:'+col+'33;">'
      +'<style>.tv-zone-row[data-zone='+zone+']::before{background:'+col+';}</style>'
      +'<div class="tv-zone-row-top">'
      +  '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">'
      +    '<div style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:'+col+';flex-shrink:0;"></div>'
      +    '<div class="tv-zone-name" style="color:'+col+';">'+zone+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div class="tv-zone-amt" style="color:'+col+';">'+fmtAmt(zAmt)+'</div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;">'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Funnel Leads</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);">'+zLeads+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Even Pay</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+zEP+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Added Today</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:#e91e8c;">'+zADP+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'<div class="tv-zone-bar-track">'
      +  '<div class="tv-zone-bar-fill" style="width:'+barW+'%;background:'+col+';"></div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'</div>';
  }).join('');
}

function _buildZoneHTML(cities){
  var zColors={North:'#4a90d9',South:'#2ecc71',West:'#f5a623'};
  return ['North','South','West'].map(function(zone){
    var zc  = cities.filter(function(c){return c.zone===zone;});
    var col = zColors[zone]||'#2ecc71';
    var zPa = zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paidAmt;},0);
    var zAmt= zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.amount;},0);
    var zP  = zc.reduce(function(s,c){return s+c.paid;},0);
    var zEP = zc.reduce(function(s,c){
      return s+c.rows.filter(function(r){return typeof hasEvenPay==='function'&&hasEvenPay(r)&&isPaid(r);}).length;
    },0);
    var zADP= zc.reduce(function(s,c){
      return s+c.rows.filter(function(r){return typeof isAddedDuring==='function'&&isAddedDuring(r)&&isPaid(r);}).length;
    },0);
    var barW= zAmt>0 ? Math.min(100,Math.round(zPa/zAmt*100)) : 0;
    return '<div class="tv-zone-row" style="border-color:'+col+'33;">'
      +'<div class="tv-zone-row-top">'
      +  '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;">'
      +    '<div style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:'+col+';flex-shrink:0;"></div>'
      +    '<div class="tv-zone-name" style="color:'+col+';">'+zone+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div class="tv-zone-amt" style="color:'+col+';">'+fmtAmt(zPa)+'</div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px;">'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Payments</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);">'+zP+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Even Pay</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:#2ecc71;">'+zEP+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +  '<div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.58rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px;">Added Today</div>'
      +    '<div style="font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;color:#e91e8c;">'+zADP+'</div>'
      +  '</div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'<div class="tv-zone-bar-track">'
      +  '<div class="tv-zone-bar-fill" style="width:'+barW+'%;background:'+col+';"></div>'
      +'</div>'
      +'</div>';
  }).join('');
}


/* ═══ GESTURE CONTROLS — Google Maps feel ══════════════════ */
(function() {
  var _tx = 0, _ty = 0;

  // ── Config (tuned to Google Maps feel) ──
  var WHEEL_SCALE    = 0.0003;   // MUCH gentler wheel — 3px delta = ~0.1% zoom
  var PINCH_DAMPING  = 0.18;     // Very soft pinch — no jumpy scale
  var PAN_DAMPING    = 0.88;     // Long momentum coast like Maps
  var MIN_SCALE      = 0.6;
  var MAX_SCALE      = 6.0;
  var DBTAP_MS       = 280;      // double-tap window
  var MIN_PINCH_DIST = 22;       // filter tiny finger noise
  var DBTAP_ZOOM     = 1.5;      // Maps zooms gently on double-tap

  function getImg()  { return document.getElementById('mapImg');  }
  function getArea() { return document.getElementById('mapArea'); }

  function applyTransform(scale, tx, ty, animate) {
    var img = getImg(); if (!img) return;
    _mapScale = scale; _tx = tx; _ty = ty;
    if (animate) {
      img.style.transition = 'transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 1)';
      setTimeout(function(){ img.style.transition = ''; }, 270);
    } else {
      img.style.transition = '';
    }
    img.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
    img.style.transform = 'translate('+tx.toFixed(2)+'px,'+ty.toFixed(2)+'px) scale('+scale.toFixed(4)+')';
    clearTimeout(img._pinTimer);
    img._pinTimer = setTimeout(function(){
      if (typeof buildCityData==='function') placeMarkers(buildCityData());
    }, animate ? 280 : 120);
  }

  function clamp(scale, tx, ty) {
    var area = getArea(); if (!area) return [tx, ty];
    var aw = area.clientWidth, ah = area.clientHeight;
    // Allow 40% of map to go offscreen each side
    var pad = 0.4;
    var maxTx =  aw * pad;
    var minTx = -(aw * scale - aw * (1 - pad));
    var maxTy =  ah * pad;
    var minTy = -(ah * scale - ah * (1 - pad));
    return [
      Math.min(maxTx, Math.max(minTx, tx)),
      Math.min(maxTy, Math.max(minTy, ty))
    ];
  }

  // ── State ──
  var _touches = [], _lastTap = 0;
  var _isPinching = false;
  var _pinchStartScale = 1, _pinchStartDist = 0;
  var _pinchStartMidX = 0, _pinchStartMidY = 0;
  var _pinchStartTx = 0, _pinchStartTy = 0;
  var _panStartX = 0, _panStartY = 0;
  var _panStartTx = 0, _panStartTy = 0;
  // Momentum
  var _velX = 0, _velY = 0, _lastMoveTime = 0;
  var _prevPanX = 0, _prevPanY = 0;
  var _momentum = null;

  function stopMomentum() {
    if (_momentum) { cancelAnimationFrame(_momentum); _momentum = null; }
    _velX = 0; _velY = 0;
  }

  function startMomentum() {
    if (Math.abs(_velX) < 0.5 && Math.abs(_velY) < 0.5) return;
    function step() {
      _velX *= PAN_DAMPING; _velY *= PAN_DAMPING;
      if (Math.abs(_velX) < 0.3 && Math.abs(_velY) < 0.3) {
        _momentum = null; return;
      }
      var c = clamp(_mapScale, _tx + _velX, _ty + _velY);
      applyTransform(_mapScale, c[0], c[1], false);
      _momentum = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }
    _momentum = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function dist2(t) {
    var dx = t[0].clientX - t[1].clientX, dy = t[0].clientY - t[1].clientY;
    return Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
  }
  function mid2(t, rect) {
    return {
      x: (t[0].clientX + t[1].clientX) / 2 - rect.left,
      y: (t[0].clientY + t[1].clientY) / 2 - rect.top
    };
  }

  function setup() {
    var area = getArea();
    if (!area) { setTimeout(setup, 400); return; }
    area.style.cursor = 'grab';
    area.style.touchAction = 'none';
    area.style.userSelect = 'none';

    // ── TOUCH START ──
    area.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      stopMomentum();
      _touches = Array.from(e.touches);

      if (_touches.length === 1) {
        var t = _touches[0], now = Date.now();
        // Double-tap detection
        if (now - _lastTap < DBTAP_MS && !_isPinching) {
          e.preventDefault();
          var rect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
          var px = t.clientX - rect.left, py = t.clientY - rect.top;
          var ns = Math.min(_mapScale * DBTAP_ZOOM, MAX_SCALE);
          var ntx = px - (px - _tx) * (ns / _mapScale);
          var nty = py - (py - _ty) * (ns / _mapScale);
          var c = clamp(ns, ntx, nty);
          applyTransform(ns, c[0], c[1], true);
          _lastTap = 0; return;
        }
        _lastTap = now;
        _isPinching = false;
        _panStartX  = t.clientX; _panStartY  = t.clientY;
        _panStartTx = _tx;       _panStartTy = _ty;
        _prevPanX = t.clientX;   _prevPanY   = t.clientY;
        _lastMoveTime = now;

      } else if (_touches.length === 2) {
        e.preventDefault();
        _isPinching = true; _lastTap = 0;
        var rect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
        var d = dist2(_touches);
        if (d < MIN_PINCH_DIST) return;
        _pinchStartDist  = d;
        _pinchStartScale = _mapScale;
        _pinchStartTx    = _tx;
        _pinchStartTy    = _ty;
        var m = mid2(_touches, rect);
        _pinchStartMidX = m.x; _pinchStartMidY = m.y;
      }
    }, { passive: false });

    // ── TOUCH MOVE ──
    area.addEventListener('touchmove', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      _touches = Array.from(e.touches);
      var now = Date.now();

      if (_touches.length === 1 && !_isPinching) {
        var t = _touches[0];
        var dx = t.clientX - _panStartX, dy = t.clientY - _panStartY;
        // Track velocity for momentum
        var dt = now - _lastMoveTime;
        if (dt > 0) {
          _velX = (t.clientX - _prevPanX) / dt * 16;  // ~60fps
          _velY = (t.clientY - _prevPanY) / dt * 16;
        }
        _prevPanX = t.clientX; _prevPanY = t.clientY; _lastMoveTime = now;
        var c = clamp(_mapScale, _panStartTx + dx, _panStartTy + dy);
        applyTransform(_mapScale, c[0], c[1], false);

      } else if (_touches.length === 2) {
        var rect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
        var d = dist2(_touches);
        if (d < MIN_PINCH_DIST || _pinchStartDist < MIN_PINCH_DIST) return;
        var m = mid2(_touches, rect);

        // Scale: relative to pinch START (not last frame — prevents jitter)
        var rawScale = _pinchStartScale * (d / _pinchStartDist);
        // Apply damping: blend toward raw scale
        var ns = _mapScale + (rawScale - _mapScale) * PINCH_DAMPING;
        ns = Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Math.max(MIN_SCALE, ns));

        // Translate: zoom toward pinch midpoint + follow mid movement
        var midDx = m.x - _pinchStartMidX;
        var midDy = m.y - _pinchStartMidY;
        var ntx = _pinchStartMidX - (_pinchStartMidX - _pinchStartTx) * (ns / _pinchStartScale) + midDx;
        var nty = _pinchStartMidY - (_pinchStartMidY - _pinchStartTy) * (ns / _pinchStartScale) + midDy;
        var c = clamp(ns, ntx, nty);
        applyTransform(ns, c[0], c[1], false);
      }
    }, { passive: false });

    // ── TOUCH END ──
    area.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      _touches = Array.from(e.touches);
      if (_touches.length === 0) {
        if (!_isPinching) startMomentum();
        _isPinching = false;
      }
      if (_touches.length < 2) _isPinching = false;
    });

    // ── MOUSE WHEEL (Google Maps: zoom to cursor, gentle steps) ──
    area.addEventListener('wheel', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      stopMomentum();
      var rect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
      var mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;

      // Normalise delta — clamp per-event to avoid trackpad bursts
      var raw   = e.deltaMode === 1 ? e.deltaY * 20
                : e.deltaMode === 2 ? e.deltaY * 300
                : e.deltaY;
      // Clamp to ±100px equivalent so one trackpad swipe can't jump too far
      var delta = Math.max(-100, Math.min(100, raw));

      var factor = Math.exp(-delta * WHEEL_SCALE);
      var ns = Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Math.max(MIN_SCALE, _mapScale * factor));
      var ntx = mx - (mx - _tx) * (ns / _mapScale);
      var nty = my - (my - _ty) * (ns / _mapScale);
      var c = clamp(ns, ntx, nty);
      applyTransform(ns, c[0], c[1], false);
    }, { passive: false });

    // ── MOUSE DRAG ──
    var _drag = false, _dragX = 0, _dragY = 0;
    area.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
      if (e.button !== 0 || e.target.closest('.marker')) return;
      stopMomentum();
      _drag = true;
      _dragX = e.clientX; _dragY = e.clientY;
      _panStartTx = _tx;  _panStartTy = _ty;
      _prevPanX = e.clientX; _prevPanY = e.clientY;
      _lastMoveTime = Date.now();
      area.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
      if (!_drag) return;
      var now = Date.now(), dt = now - _lastMoveTime;
      if (dt > 0) {
        _velX = (e.clientX - _prevPanX) / dt * 16;
        _velY = (e.clientY - _prevPanY) / dt * 16;
      }
      _prevPanX = e.clientX; _prevPanY = e.clientY; _lastMoveTime = now;
      var c = clamp(_mapScale, _panStartTx + e.clientX - _dragX, _panStartTy + e.clientY - _dragY);
      applyTransform(_mapScale, c[0], c[1], false);
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', function() {
      if (_drag) { _drag = false; area.style.cursor = 'grab'; startMomentum(); }
    });
  }

  // ── Public API ──
  window._gestureReset = function() {
    stopMomentum();
    applyTransform(1.3, 0, 0, true);
  };
  window._gestureZoomAt = function(cx, cy, factor) {
    stopMomentum();
    var ns = Math.min(MAX_SCALE, Math.max(MIN_SCALE, _mapScale * factor));
    var c  = clamp(ns, cx - (cx - _tx) * (ns / _mapScale), cy - (cy - _ty) * (ns / _mapScale));
    applyTransform(ns, c[0], c[1], true);
  };

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setup);
  else setup();
  setTimeout(setup, 500);
})();

function init() { renderAll(); loadSheet(); }
mapImg.addEventListener('load', init);
if (mapImg.complete) init();

  clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

});

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   COLLAPSIBLE TOGGLE
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
function toggleSection(sectionId, btnId) {
  var el  = document.getElementById(sectionId);
  var btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  if (!el) return;
  var isOpen = el.style.display !== 'none';
  el.style.display  = isOpen ? 'none' : '';
  if (btn) {
    btn.textContent = isOpen ? '▼ VIEW' : '▲ HIDE';
    btn.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   MAP ZOOM
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
var _mapScale = 1.3;

function _zoomAt(cx, cy, factor) { if(window._gestureZoomAt){window._gestureZoomAt(cx,cy,factor);return;}
  if (window._gestureZoomAt) { window._gestureZoomAt(cx, cy, factor); return; }
  // Use the same system as mapZoom - scale on #mapImg
  var img = document.getElementById('mapImg');
  var area = document.getElementById('mapArea');
  if (!img || !area) { mapZoom(factor); return; }
  var curScale = _mapScale || 1;
  var newScale = Math.min(4, Math.max(0.4, curScale * factor));
  _mapScale = newScale;
  // Set transform-origin to clicked point so zoom centres on city
  var aRect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
  var pctX = Math.round((cx / aRect.width) * 100);
  var pctY = Math.round((cy / aRect.height) * 100);
  img.style.transformOrigin = pctX + '% ' + pctY + '%';
  img.style.transform = 'scale(' + newScale + ')';
  // Re-render markers after zoom
  setTimeout(function(){ var c = buildCityData(); placeMarkers(c); }, 80);
}
function autoFocusMap(cities) {
  if (!cities) cities = buildCityData();
  var img  = document.getElementById('mapImg');
  var area = document.getElementById('mapArea');
  if (!img || !area) return;

  // Filter cities with data
  var active = cities.filter(function(c){ return (c.with + c.without) > 0; });
  if (!active.length) return;

  // Compute weighted centroid using lead count as weight
  var totalW = 0, sumX = 0, sumY = 0;
  var minX = 999, maxX = 0, minY = 999, maxY = 0;
  active.forEach(function(c) {
    var w = c.with + c.without;
    sumX += c.px * w; sumY += c.py * w; totalW += w;
    if (c.px < minX) minX = c.px; if (c.px > maxX) maxX = c.px;
    if (c.py < minY) minY = c.py; if (c.py > maxY) maxY = c.py;
  });
  var cx = sumX / totalW; // centroid in natural px coords
  var cy = sumY / totalW;

  // Compute scale to fit all active cities with padding
  var padX = 80, padY = 80;
  var spanX = (maxX - minX) + padX * 2;
  var spanY = (maxY - minY) + padY * 2;
  var aRect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
  var scaleX = aRect.width  / (spanX / NAT_W * aRect.width);
  var scaleY = aRect.height / (spanY / NAT_H * aRect.height);
  var scale  = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 3.0);  // cap at 3x
  scale = Math.max(scale, 1.0);                 // min 1x

  // Compute translation to centre the centroid on screen
  var scX = aRect.width  / NAT_W;
  var scY = aRect.height / NAT_H;
  var pinX = cx * scX;  // centroid in screen coords at scale=1
  var pinY = cy * scY;
  var tx = (aRect.width  / 2 - pinX * scale) / scale * (scale - 1);
  var ty = (aRect.height / 2 - pinY * scale) / scale * (scale - 1);
  // Simpler: translate so centroid is at centre after scaling
  tx = aRect.width  / 2 - pinX * scale;
  ty = aRect.height / 2 - pinY * scale;

  // Smooth transition
  img.style.willChange = 'transform';
  img.style.transition = 'transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)';
  img.style.transformOrigin = '0 0';
  img.style.transform = 'translate('+tx.toFixed(1)+'px,'+ty.toFixed(1)+'px) scale('+scale.toFixed(2)+')';
  _mapScale = scale;

  // Update slider
  

  // Remove transition after animation, re-render pins
  setTimeout(function(){
    img.style.transition = '';
    img.style.willChange = 'auto';
    var c = buildCityData(); placeMarkers(c);
  }, 950);
}


function mapPan(dx, dy) {
  var img  = document.getElementById('mapImg');
  var area = document.getElementById('mapArea');
  if (!img || !area) return;
  // Use CSS translate on the map image for panning
  var cur = img.style.transform || '';
  var tx = 0, ty = 0;
  var m = cur.match(/translate\(([-\d.]+)px,\s*([-\d.]+)px\)/);
  if (m) { tx = parseFloat(m[1]); ty = parseFloat(m[2]); }
  tx += dx; ty += dy;
  var scaleMatch = cur.match(/scale\(([\d.]+)\)/);
  var sc = scaleMatch ? scaleMatch[1] : (_mapScale || 1);
  img.style.transform = 'translate('+tx+'px,'+ty+'px) scale('+sc+')';
  setTimeout(function(){ var c=buildCityData(); placeMarkers(c); }, 50);
}

function mapZoom(factor) {
  _mapScale = Math.min(3, Math.max(0.4, _mapScale * factor));
  var img = document.getElementById('mapImg');
  if (img) img.style.transform = 'scale('+_mapScale+')';
  // Reposition markers after zoom
  setTimeout(function(){ var c=buildCityData(); placeMarkers(c); }, 60);
}

function mapReset() { if(window._gestureReset){window._gestureReset();return;} _mapScale=1.3; var img=document.getElementById('mapImg'); if(img){img.style.transformOrigin='0 0';img.style.transform='translate(0,0) scale(1.3)';} setTimeout(function(){var c=buildCityData();placeMarkers(c);},100); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════
   RESIZE HANDLES
═══════════════════════════════════════ */
(function() {

  /* ── Header vertical resize ── */
  var rhHeader = document.getElementById('rh-header');
  var topbar   = document.querySelector('.topbar');
  var startY, startH;

  rhHeader.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    startY = e.clientY;
    startH = topbar.offsetHeight;
    rhHeader.classList.add('dragging');
    document.body.style.cursor = 'ns-resize';
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

    function onMove(e) {
      var newH = Math.max(44, Math.min(140, startH + (e.clientY - startY)));
      topbar.style.height = newH + 'px';
    }
    function onUp() {
      rhHeader.classList.remove('dragging');
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  });

  /* ── Left sidebar resize ── */
  var rvLeft   = document.getElementById('rv-left');
  var sidebar  = document.querySelector('.sidebar');
  var startX, startW;

  rvLeft.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    startX = e.clientX;
    startW = sidebar.offsetWidth;
    rvLeft.classList.add('dragging');
    document.body.style.cursor = 'ew-resize';
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

    function onMove(e) {
      var newW = Math.max(160, Math.min(420, startW + (e.clientX - startX)));
      sidebar.style.width = newW + 'px';
      // Reposition map markers after resize
      clearTimeout(sidebar._rt);
      sidebar._rt = setTimeout(function(){ var cities = buildCityData(); placeMarkers(cities); }, 60);
    }
    function onUp() {
      rvLeft.classList.remove('dragging');
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  });

  /* ── Right panel resize ── */
  var rvRight  = document.getElementById('rv-right');
  var rightP   = document.getElementById('rightPanel');
  var startXR, startWR;

  rvRight.addEventListener('mousedown', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    startXR = e.clientX;
    startWR = rightP.offsetWidth;
    rvRight.classList.add('dragging');
    document.body.style.cursor = 'ew-resize';
    document.body.style.userSelect = 'none';

    function onMove(e) {
      var newW = Math.max(180, Math.min(500, startWR - (e.clientX - startXR)));
      rightP.style.width = newW + 'px';
      clearTimeout(rightP._rt);
      rightP._rt = setTimeout(function(){ var cities = buildCityData(); placeMarkers(cities); }, 60);
    }
    function onUp() {
      rvRight.classList.remove('dragging');
      document.body.style.cursor = '';
      document.body.style.userSelect = '';
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
  });

  /* ── Touch support for all resizers ── */
  function addTouch(el, getStart, getSize, setSize, repin) {
    el.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var t = e.touches[0];
      var s0 = getStart(t);
      var w0 = getSize();
      el.classList.add('dragging');

      function onMove(e) {
        var t2 = e.touches[0];
        setSize(w0, t2, s0);
        if (repin) { clearTimeout(el._rt); el._rt = setTimeout(function(){ var cities=buildCityData(); placeMarkers(cities); }, 60); }
      }
      function onUp() {
        el.classList.remove('dragging');
        el.removeEventListener('touchmove', onMove);
        el.removeEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      }
      el.addEventListener('touchmove', onMove);
      el.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
    }, { passive: false });
  }

  addTouch(rhHeader,
    function(t){ return t.clientY; },
    function(){ return topbar.offsetHeight; },
    function(w0, t, s0){ var newH = Math.max(44, Math.min(140, w0 + (t.clientY - s0))); topbar.style.height = newH+'px'; },
    false
  );
  addTouch(rvLeft,
    function(t){ return t.clientX; },
    function(){ return sidebar.offsetWidth; },
    function(w0, t, s0){ var newW = Math.max(160, Math.min(420, w0 + (t.clientX - s0))); sidebar.style.width = newW+'px'; },
    true
  );
  addTouch(rvRight,
    function(t){ return t.clientX; },
    function(){ return rightP.offsetWidth; },
    function(w0, t, s0){ var newW = Math.max(180, Math.min(500, w0 - (t.clientX - s0))); rightP.style.width = newW+'px'; },
    true
  );

})();</script>
